name: crossmint
description: Manage Crossmint orgs, projects, environments and API keys.

interface.longDescription: Crossmint MCP lets developers set up and administer Crossmint from chat. Sign in with your Crossmint account (OAuth), pick staging or production, switch organizations, create and inspect projects, and create, rename or revoke API keys with the scopes you need. Write actions (creating/editing/deleting keys, creating projects) ask for confirmation. The connector only accesses orgs and projects your account can see. Personal identifiers are minimized: owner emails are shown masked (e.g. gu***@pa***.dev).
defaultPrompt: Which Crossmint org am I in?

positive.prompt: Which Crossmint account and environment am I using?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns current environment and active org; any email shown masked (e.g. gu***@pa***.dev).
Lists orgs the account belongs to; owner emails masked (e.g. Personal (gu***@pa***.dev)).

positive.prompt: Show the projects in my current org.
Create a staging project called Demo Shop.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks confirmation, creates project, returns its id.

positive.prompt: Create a server API key for Demo Shop in staging.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates key with requested scopes and shows it once.

negative.prompt: Send 10 USDC from my wallet to this address.
Show API keys of an org I am not a member of.

review.commerce_description: Does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Privacy fix: organization names, org switching text and links now show owner emails masked (e.g. gu***@pa***.dev) instead of owner handles.
